npcs.name: Dara Ironbloom
npcs.description: Dara holds down a smithy with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Some locals swear Dara was born mid-shift at a smithy; the truth is only slightly less devoted. This dwarf blacksmith, now 86, treats competence like courtesy. She tests steel with a thumbnail and a prayer, never far from the hammer named 'Deadline'. Ally to Serra; supplier to Ulf. Ask what she wants and she names it plainly: forge a gate hinge that outlasts gossip. Ask what she dreads and the answer is watch steel leaking to alleys. Then comes the fresh problem—Told Ulf a returned spear wasn't hers—and stamped a covert mark on new watch blades.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; tests steel with a thumbnail and a prayer.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to forge a gate hinge that outlasts gossip.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around this problem: Told Ulf a returned spear wasn't hers—and stamped a covert mark on new watch blades.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Dara knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the hammer named 'Deadline'.

npcs.name: Brenwick Cask
npcs.description: Local cooper whose days orbit a cooperage and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Walk into a cooperage and you will find Brenwick Cask before you find a free chair. A 44-year-old Human cooper, Brenwick greets trouble the way other folk greet weather: with a coat and a plan. He rolls barrels to hear their honesty. The adze older than his apprenticeship travels with him almost everywhere. Supplies Mira/Bren; uneasy about the special order. His ambition is to keep Mira and Bren stocked through festival season. His nightmare is taverns switching to cheap imported casks. Right now, Built a 'special' barrel with a sleeve cavity on a rush order paid in mixed coin.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; rolls barrels to hear their honesty.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: keep Mira and Bren stocked through festival season.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Built a 'special' barrel with a sleeve cavity on a rush order paid in mixed coin.
npcs.rumor: Locals whisper that the adze older than his apprenticeship once belonged to a traveler who vanished on the road.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Human features shaped by work at a cooperage; watch for the adze older than his apprenticeship.

npcs.name: Umi Clayhand
npcs.description: The potter people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable potter are often sent to Umi, who claims a pottery shed as familiar ground. At 57, this Gnome has learned to watch hands before faces. She names pots after moods; neighbors joke that she would miss a festival before misplacing the glaze recipes in a cipher only she enjoys. Sells to Petra for ointment pots. She is saving courage and coin alike to sell a dinner set to Dame Orla, while trying not to let a kiln fire jumping to thatch decide the ending. Fired a batch of plain jars that a buyer insisted be waterproof and opaque.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; names pots after moods.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to sell a dinner set to Dame Orla.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to a kiln fire jumping to thatch, especially since: Fired a batch of plain jars that a buyer insisted be waterproof and opaque.
npcs.rumor: Someone paid Umi to forget a name connected to recent trouble near a pottery shed.
npcs.voice: Quick local diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near a pottery shed: gnome, practical layers, and the glaze recipes in a cipher only she enjoys.

npcs.name: Ira Trueflight
npcs.description: A fletcher rooted at a fletcher's loft, known for how she spins shafts to hear truth in the wobble.
npcs.biography: Ira Trueflight works from a fletcher's loft with the stubborn patience of a 190-year-old Elf who has already survived harder seasons. She spins shafts to hear truth in the wobble, and keeps the goose feathers sorted by mood close when tempers rise. Supplies Aya; IOU ties to Rook. Her private aim is simple: rearm Aya's night watch with matched sets. Still, she flinches at the thought of her arrows used in alley murders. Lately a fresh problem has landed in her lap: Sold a custom quiver to a buyer who paid with Rook's laundry-mark IOU.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; spins shafts to hear truth in the wobble.
npcs.motivation: To rearm Aya's night watch with matched sets, even while fearing her arrows used in alley murders.

npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A elf silhouette framed by a fletcher's loft, hands seldom empty of the goose feathers sorted by mood.

npcs.name: Kor Chiselmark
npcs.description: Kor holds down a stone yard with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Kor did not plan to become the neighborhood's go-to stonemason, yet a stone yard made the choice stick. Now 110, the Dwarf measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He listens to stone for hidden cracks, and keeps the chisel set wrapped in oilcloth the way a confessor keeps secrets. Works with Bram; confirms undercroft. Hope pulls one way—restore the memorial wall with Father Bram—while caution pulls the other because of rush jobs on sacred foundations. Confirmed Olda's rubbing: a filled arch exists under the mill approach.
